ResearchProjectDef.label: alien shuttle engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Adapt recovered alien flight-control, hull and transport systems into craft that can be built, boarded and launched using proven colony shuttle procedures.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Wraith flight systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reverse-engineer Wraith organic flight controls, culling storage and living propulsion sufficiently to construct and operate Darts, scout craft and cruiser transports.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ancient shuttle systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reconstruct the control and flight architecture of Ancient gate-capable shuttles while retaining native colony boarding, transport and launch procedures.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Goa'uld shuttle integration
ResearchProjectDef.description: Combine colony shuttle engineering with recovered Goa'uld propulsion and ONAC naquadah-processing technology to construct Al'kesh-class transport and strike craft.
